notes: SYNTHETIC. Every party, agent, contact reference and identifier below is invented. Parties are marked (FICTIONAL), addresses use .example domains and RFC 5737 / RFC 3849 literals, and no real customer, institution or conversation is represented.
headline: Late: the recording notice came four minutes after the call opened.

turns.text: Good morning, you are through to Meridian Trust Bank (FICTIONAL). How can I help?
I wanted to ask about the balanced income fund.
Of course. Could you confirm your date of birth for me please?
Sorry, I should have said at the start: this call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Thank you. The purpose of this call is to review the balanced income fund you asked us about last week.
I must tell you that the value of your investment can go down as well as up, and you may get back less than you invested.
I should also set out the fees and charges that apply: a sales charge of up to five per cent, and an annual management fee.
That is very helpful, thank you for explaining.
Are you happy to proceed with the application today?
Thank you. If anything is not right, you can raise a complaint at any time and we will look into it.
